findings.summary: cython_generate --validate rejects the repository's generated Annoy Cython source because legitimate doubled braces in CSS/JavaScript are mistaken for unprocessed Tempita markers.
findings.resolution: validate_generated_files compares each X with its X.in rendered again; no brace search, so CSS/JS doubled braces pass and stale or edited outputs fail.

findings.summary: cython_generate documents atomic output, but process_template writes the final file directly with Path.write_text rather than staging and replacing it.
findings.resolution: process_template writes through _write_atomically (temporary file in the same directory, then os.replace); a failed write keeps the previous output and leaves no temporary.

findings.summary: gitversion.add_safe_directory error paths reference exception variable e after its except scope (and from a ValueError handler that binds ve), causing UnboundLocalError instead of the documented fallback result.
findings.resolution: add_safe_directory and the shared _run_git return non-zero codes with messages on every failure (1 invalid path, 127 git not runnable, git's own code); no exception name is read outside its handler.

findings.summary: git_version retries any git return code 128 by globally adding the _build_utils subdirectory as safe.directory; this is persistent user Git configuration and is not the repository root.
findings.resolution: git_version no longer calls add_safe_directory: on return code 128 with Git's 'dubious ownership' message it retries once with git -c safe.directory=<top level Git names>; nothing is written to any Git configuration, other failures are not retried.

findings.summary: install_meson_features._needs_update relies on source-vs-destination mtimes and source names only, so content drift with newer destination timestamps and stale destination-only files can be accepted as up to date.
findings.resolution: _needs_update compares the file sets and bytes (filecmp, shallow=False) of source and destination, recursively, ignoring bytecode; copytree no longer copies __pycache__. Verified live with meson 1.12.1.

findings.summary: copy_file fails for an ordinary destination filename in the current directory because os.path.dirname(dest) is empty and os.makedirs("") raises FileNotFoundError.
findings.resolution: copy_file creates the parent directory only when dest has one; tqdm is imported only for progress=True, so the module imports without it.

findings.summary: test_gitversion imports the production git-version APIs but never calls them; its green tests mostly re-simulate expected behavior and therefore miss the real error-path defects.
findings.resolution: test_gitversion calls git_version on a real repository, a stand-in git (dubious ownership, other failures, a Git ignoring command-line trust), no git, and add_safe_directory's error paths; test_cython_generate, test_install_meson_features and test_copyfiles are new.
